from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

# Login Venmo
venmo_pwd = [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='kri-powe@gmail.com', password=venmo_pwd)['access_token']

# Parse shares from note 3084 (already known)
shares = {'Adrian': 36.0, 'Katie': 30.0, 'Martin': 35.0, 'Robin': 36.0, 'Matthew': 19.0, 'Melissa': 31.0, 'Glenn': 32.0, 'Brenda': 40.0}

now=datetime.now()
yesterday=(now-timedelta(days=1)).date().isoformat()
today=now.date().isoformat()

# fetch received tx yesterday..today
page_index=0
page_limit=20
received=[]
while True:
    resp=apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        direction='received',
        min_created_at=yesterday,
        max_created_at=today,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit
    )
    if not resp:
        break
    received.extend(resp)
    if len(resp)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1

paid_emails=set([tx['sender']['email'] for tx in received])
received_desc=[tx.get('description') for tx in received]
print('received_count', len(received))
print('paid_emails', paid_emails)
print('descs', sorted(set(received_desc)))

# map note-name substrings
paid_note_names=set()
for tx in received:
    sname=(tx['sender']['name'] or '')
    for nm in shares.keys():
        if nm.lower() in sname.lower():
            paid_note_names.add(nm)
print('paid_note_names', paid_note_names)

unpaid={nm:amt for nm,amt in shares.items() if nm not in paid_note_names}
print('unpaid', unpaid)

# Login to phone app and search contacts for unpaid names
from datetime import datetime

super_pw = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
phone_pwd = [x['password'] for x in super_pw if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='6017026518', password=phone_pwd)['access_token']
print('phone_token', phone_token[:20])

unpaid_names=['Adrian','Katie','Melissa','Glenn']

def search_all_contacts(query):
    res=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp=apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        res.extend(resp)
        if len(resp)<page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1
    return res

for nm in unpaid_names:
    contacts=search_all_contacts(nm)
    print('\nNAME',nm,'contacts_found',len(contacts))
    # show up to 10
    for c in contacts[:10]:
        print(' ',c.get('contact_id'),c.get('first_name'),c.get('last_name'),c.get('email'),c.get('phone_number'),c.get('relationships'))

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

# Login helper

def get_pwd(app_name):
    return [x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']==app_name][0]

# --- login to apps ---
user_email='kri-powe@gmail.com'

simple_token = apis.simple_note.login(username=user_email, password=get_pwd('simple_note'))['access_token']
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username=user_email, password=get_pwd('venmo'))['access_token']
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='6017026518', password=get_pwd('phone'))['access_token']

# --- get most recent expense shares note ---
notes=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=simple_token, query='Friends Dinner', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    notes.extend(resp)
    if len(resp)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1

expense_notes=[n for n in notes if 'Expense Shares' in (n.get('title') or '')]
chosen_note=max(expense_notes, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at') or '') if expense_notes else max(notes, key=lambda x: x.get('created_at') or '')

note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=chosen_note['note_id'], access_token=simple_token)

shares=[]
for line in note['content'].splitlines():
    m=re.match(r"-\s*(.+?)\s*=>\s*\$(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*$", line.strip())
    if m:
        shares.append((m.group(1).strip(), float(m.group(2))))

shares_map={k:v for k,v in shares}
print('chosen_note', chosen_note['note_id'], chosen_note['title'], chosen_note['created_at'])
print('shares', shares_map)

# --- dinner time window: yesterday..today (per current datetime.now()) ---
now=datetime.now()
yesterday=(now-timedelta(days=1)).date().isoformat()
today=now.date().isoformat()

# --- determine who already paid via Venmo received tx with description Friends Dinner ---
received=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    resp=apis.venmo.show_transactions(
        access_token=venmo_token,
        direction='received',
        min_created_at=yesterday,
        max_created_at=today,
        page_index=page_index,
        page_limit=page_limit,
    )
    if not resp:
        break
    received.extend(resp)
    if len(resp)<page_limit:
        break
    page_index+=1

paid_sender_emails=set()
for tx in received:
    if tx.get('description')=='Friends Dinner':
        paid_sender_emails.add(tx.get('sender',{}).get('email'))

print('received_tx_count',len(received),'paid_sender_emails',paid_sender_emails)

# --- map each share name to exactly one phone contact email (relationship=friend, exact first_name match) ---

def phone_emails_for_firstname(first_name):
    # search by query exact first name, then filter by exact first_name match
    res=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        resp=apis.phone.search_contacts(
            access_token=phone_token,
            query=first_name,
            relationship='friend',
            page_index=page_index,
            page_limit=page_limit,
        )
        if not resp:
            break
        res.extend(resp)
        if len(resp)<page_limit:
            break
        page_index+=1
    filt=[c for c in res if (c.get('first_name') or '').strip().lower()==first_name.strip().lower() and c.get('email')]
    return filt

name_to_email={}
for name in shares_map.keys():
    candidates=phone_emails_for_firstname(name)
    emails=sorted(set(c['email'] for c in candidates))
    print('phone candidates for',name,'count',len(candidates),'emails',emails)
    if len(emails)!=1:
        raise Exception(f'Ambiguous phone contact email for {name}: {emails}')
    name_to_email[name]=emails[0]

# --- determine unpaid ---
unpaid=[]
for name,amt in shares_map.items():
    email=name_to_email[name]
    if email not in paid_sender_emails:
        unpaid.append({'name':name,'email':email,'amount':amt})

print('unpaid',unpaid)

# --- check existing sent payment requests in date window and skip duplicates ---

def existing_sent_for_receiver(receiver_email, amount, desc='Friends Dinner'):
    # returns list of matches
    matches=[]
    for status in ['pending','approved','denied']:
        page_index=0
        page_limit=20
        while True:
            resp=apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(
                access_token=venmo_token,
                query=receiver_email,
                status=status,
                page_index=page_index,
                page_limit=page_limit,
            )
            if not resp:
                break
            for pr in resp:
                if pr.get('receiver',{}).get('email')==receiver_email and pr.get('description')==desc and pr.get('amount')==amount:
                    # check created_at date in [yesterday,today]
                    ca=(pr.get('created_at') or '')[:10]
                    if ca in [yesterday,today]:
                        matches.append(pr)
            if len(resp)<page_limit:
                break
            page_index+=1
    return matches

# --- create payment requests ---
created=[]
for item in unpaid:
    matches=existing_sent_for_receiver(item['email'], item['amount'])
    print('existing matches for',item,'count',len(matches))
    if matches:
        continue
    pr=apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=item['email'],
        amount=item['amount'],
        access_token=venmo_token,
        description='Friends Dinner',
        private=False,
    )
    created.append(pr)
    print('created',pr)

print('created_count',len(created))
